cases.name: Verify the footnote is visible to visitors as well as the owner, not only to the owner
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: A footnote is configured on the storefront.
cases.desc: Confirms the configured footnote is displayed across viewer perspectives: the owner sees the content plus an edit control, while a logged-out visitor sees the same content without any edit control.

steps.desc: As the owner, view the storefront bottom
steps.result: The footnote content is shown together with an "Edit footer" CTA

steps.desc: As a logged-out visitor (private window), view the storefront bottom
steps.result: The same footnote content is shown with no edit control

cases.name: Verify editing an existing footnote updates it everywhere and clearing all content removes the footer section
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: A footnote is already configured on the storefront.
cases.desc: Confirms existing footnote content is loaded for editing, updates propagate to the storefront across desktop and mobile, and saving an empty footer removes the footnote section entirely.

steps.desc: Click "Edit footer"
steps.result: The editor opens pre-filled with the existing footnote content

steps.desc: Modify the content (e.g. add a word) and click "Save"
steps.result: Both desktop and mobile storefronts show the updated footnote

steps.desc: Open the editor again, clear all content, and click "Save"
steps.result: Save succeeds and the footnote section is no longer rendered on the storefront

steps.desc: Reload the storefront
steps.result: No footnote is shown and the owner bottom entry is back to "Add footer"

cases.name: Verify the footnote does not conflict with the cookie preferences / Powered by Pear block
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: A footnote is configured on the storefront.
cases.desc: Confirms the configured footnote and the default Powered by Pear / cookie preferences area coexist without overlap and are visually tasteful on desktop and mobile.

steps.desc: View the storefront bottom on desktop
steps.result: The footnote renders above the "POWERED BY Pear" and "Cookie preferences" area with a divider and tasteful spacing; there is no overlap or clipping

steps.desc: View the storefront bottom on mobile
steps.result: Same correct, non-conflicting layout on mobile

steps.desc: Open the cookie preferences entry
steps.result: The cookie preferences entry remains accessible and is not obscured by the footnote

cases.name: Verify the footnote always stays at the very bottom and is excluded from Rearrange section
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: A footnote is configured; the storefront has multiple sections/modules.
cases.desc: Confirms the footnote is pinned to the bottom of the storefront, has a divider above it consistent with existing storefront dividers, and is not part of the Rearrange section list.

steps.desc: Open "Rearrange section" on the storefront
steps.result: The footnote is NOT listed among the rearrangeable sections

steps.desc: Reorder the available sections and save
steps.result: Other sections change order while the footnote remains at the very bottom

steps.desc: Verify the divider above the footnote
steps.result: A divider is shown above the footnote, consistent with existing storefront dividers

cases.name: Verify the footnote text color and font follow the Storefront Style settings
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: A footnote is configured on the storefront.
cases.desc: Confirms the footnote inherits its text color from style > color > text and its font from style > fonts, and cannot be overridden per footnote.

steps.desc: Open Customize shop / Style and change the text color (style > color > text)
steps.result: The footnote text color on the storefront updates accordingly

steps.desc: Change the font (style > fonts)
steps.result: The footnote font updates accordingly

steps.desc: Re-open the footnote editor and check the available controls
steps.result: The footnote still cannot override color, font size, or spacing in the RTE

cases.name: Verify the Insert link dialog requires link text and a URL and rejects an invalid URL
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: The footnote editor is open and the Insert link dialog is open.
cases.desc: Confirms required-field validation in the Insert link dialog: the Add button stays disabled until link text and a URL are provided, and an invalid URL is rejected.

steps.desc: Leave "Link text" and the URL empty and observe the "Add" button
steps.result: "Add" is disabled until the required fields are provided

steps.desc: Enter link text but leave the URL empty
steps.result: "Add" stays disabled or a validation message is shown

steps.desc: Enter an invalid URL (e.g. "abc" with no valid domain) and click "Add"
steps.result: The invalid URL is rejected; the link is not inserted and an error is shown

steps.desc: Enter a valid URL and click "Add"
steps.result: The link is inserted successfully

cases.name: Verify inserting an external link in the footnote renders it underlined and not blue
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: The footnote editor is open with text available to link.
cases.desc: Confirms the Insert link dialog defaults to "External link" and that a link inserted into the footnote is displayed underlined but never blue on the storefront.

steps.desc: Select text and click the link icon in the RTE toolbar
steps.result: The "Insert link" dialog opens

steps.desc: Check the default value of the "Action" dropdown
steps.result: "External link" is selected by default

steps.desc: Enter link text and a URL (e.g. https://example.com) and click "Add"
steps.result: The link is inserted into the footnote text

steps.desc: Save and view the footnote on the storefront
steps.result: The link is displayed with an underline but is not blue

cases.name: Verify the footnote RTE editor exposes the required quick actions with centered default alignment and no style-override controls
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.desc: Confirms the footnote RTE editor supports undo, redo, bold, underline, link and alignment (centered by default), and does not offer color, font size or spacing controls.

steps.desc: Inspect the RTE toolbar
steps.result: The toolbar shows undo, redo, bold, underline, link and alignment controls

steps.desc: Type sample text and verify the default alignment
steps.result: Text is centered by default

steps.desc: Apply bold to one word and underline to another word
steps.result: Bold and underline are applied and visible in the editor

steps.desc: Look for color, font size, or spacing controls
steps.result: No color, font size, or spacing controls are available in the RTE

cases.name: Verify "Insert copyright template" auto-fills the default copyright template text and centers it
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: The footnote editor is open with empty content.
cases.desc: Confirms that clicking "Insert copyright template" auto-fills the default template copy (privacy/terms links plus a copyright line) centered by default. Per the design this capability is low priority and may land in a later cycle.

steps.desc: Click the "Insert copyright template" link in the footnote editor
steps.result: The template copy is auto-filled into the editor: "(c) 2026 Your legal entity name. All rights reserved."

steps.desc: Check the alignment of the inserted template
steps.result: The inserted template is centered by default

steps.desc: Click "Save" and view the storefront
steps.result: The template copy renders centered at the bottom of the storefront

cases.name: Verify the footnote change takes effect on the storefront immediately after saving, without a refresh
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: A footnote is configured on the storefront and the partner is viewing their own storefront.
cases.desc: Confirms that after the partner edits and saves the footnote, the storefront bottom reflects the updated content immediately, without the user having to reload the page.

steps.desc: Open the footnote editor, modify the existing footnote text (including applying bold to part of it), and click Save
steps.result: The editor closes with a success confirmation and the change is saved

steps.desc: Without refreshing the storefront page, scroll to the bottom of the storefront
steps.result: The storefront bottom immediately shows the updated footnote content, including the bold formatting, with no page refresh required

steps.desc: Reload the storefront page and re-check the footnote
steps.result: The updated footnote persists at the bottom of the storefront

cases.name: Verify the footnote section is hidden when no footnote is configured and only an "Add footer" entry is shown to the owner
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: Partner owns a published storefront; the footnote is empty / not configured.
cases.desc: Confirms that when no footnote content is configured, no footnote section is rendered for visitors on the storefront, and the owner only sees an "Add footer" call to action.

steps.desc: As a visitor (private window), open the storefront and scroll to the very bottom
steps.result: No footnote section is rendered; the page ends with the default Powered by / cookie area

steps.desc: As the owner, open the storefront and check the bottom
steps.result: An "Add footer" CTA is displayed instead of an "Edit footer" CTA

steps.desc: Click "Add footer" and close the editor (X) without saving any content
steps.result: The editor closes; the storefront still shows no footnote section

cases.name: Verify a partner can add a storefront footnote via the RTE editor and it renders at the bottom for visitors on desktop and mobile
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront
cases.condition: Partner is logged in and owns a published storefront; no footnote is configured yet.
cases.desc: End-to-end happy path: a partner with no footnote configured opens the footnote editor from the storefront, enters content with the RTE editor, saves, and the footnote renders at the very bottom of the storefront with a divider above it for both the owner and visitors on desktop and mobile.

steps.desc: Open the partner's storefront (Shop view) and scroll to the bottom
steps.result: The bottom shows an "Add footer" CTA and no footnote section is rendered

steps.desc: Click "Add footer"
steps.result: The "Storefront footer" editor opens with the RTE toolbar visible and the content area empty

steps.desc: Enter footnote text in the RTE editor (e.g. "Contact Us | Privacy Policy | Terms & Conditions")
steps.result: The typed content appears in the editor

steps.desc: Click "Save"
steps.result: The editor closes with a success confirmation; the storefront now shows the footnote content at the bottom with a divider above it

steps.desc: Reload the storefront page and re-check the footnote position
steps.result: The footnote persists and stays at the very bottom of the storefront

steps.desc: Open the same storefront URL in a private window as a visitor and scroll to the bottom
steps.result: Visitors also see the footnote; no edit control is shown to visitors

steps.desc: Repeat the check on a mobile viewport
steps.result: The footnote renders correctly on mobile as well
